user.title: USB Relay Roller Shutter
user.description:
Configure your USB relay controlled roller shutter.

**Short Pulse Mode** ⚡
Activates the relay briefly (100-600 ms), like a push button. Ideal for motorized shutters with built-in control electronics.

**Sustained Mode** ⏱️
Keeps the relay active for the entire duration (2s-2min). For shutters requiring continuous power during movement.

The exact duration for the chosen mode will be asked in the next step.

pulse_short.title: Short pulse duration
pulse_short.description: Set the pulse duration, like a brief press on a push button.

pulse_long.title: Sustained duration
pulse_long.description: Set how long the relay stays continuously active.

data_description.long_pulse_duration: Extended activation duration (2 seconds to 2 minutes)

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the serial port. Check that the device is plugged in and the port is correct.
